title: tetraberlinia longiracemosa
intro: Tetraberlinia longiracemosa, commonly known as the 'Long Racosm Tree', is a plant species in the family Fabaceae. The health benefits associated with Tetraberlinia longiracemosa include its antimicrobial properties, which may help in wound healing and preventing infections. The therapeutic actions of this plant include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, making it a potential candidate for treating various health conditions, including arthritis and oxidative stress-related diseases. The bioactive constituents of Tetraberlinia longiracemosa include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
